findings.description: Replace `authService['_currentUser$'].value` with a public getter in AuthService (e.g., `getCurrentUser()`) to avoid breaking on refactor.

`checkActivationMethod()` always returns `'Movimiento'`. Until the backend endpoint exists, return `null` and mark as not configured, or document that this is a temporary optimistic default and must be replaced.
`cargarEstadoSeguridad()` subscribes in `ngOnInit` with no cleanup. Use `takeUntilDestroyed()` or store the subscription and unsubscribe in `ngOnDestroy()`.
`cargarZonasPeligrosas()` calls `getByUser(1)` instead of the authenticated user's ID. Use the same user object from AuthService.
